snippet.title: Hero.EXE Early Demo Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Hero.EXE is a card collecting action RPG based on the Megaman Battle Network Series. Players connect their computers to an alternate earth's internet where virtual beings called A.V.As reside. Player's must choose an Ava and embark on an adventure to save both of our worlds.

https://twitter.com/HeroEXEGame

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302770/HeroEXE/
